name: Viñoly
description: Viñoly is Rafael Viñoly Architects’ 2005 Mahler4 office tower in Zuidas. An exterior stair spirals through notches cut into its glass and aluminium facade, tying the offset podium, middle volume and tower into one composition. The planned public rooftop stair access was closed for safety before opening. Its podium contains independently serviced ground-floor retail and a glass-covered two-story patio.
